adversarial_test_results.prompt: She bought the bread and the cheese from the Saturday market, then walked home along the canal.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A thing fills the slot ('the bread and'), one of the hypothesis's own claimed silent cases, so the prediction is inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Their engineering office is at Google, on the fourth floor of the campus building.
adversarial_test_results.detail: An organisation fills the slot after 'at' ('at Google'), which the hypothesis names as a silent case, so it predicts low activation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They arrived in Boston on Friday evening and stayed through the weekend.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She put on her coat and left without saying a word to anyone.
